value.rationale: The Nauru graph is a canonical cubic symmetric generalized Petersen graph. Its exact finite ordinary matching-complex homotopy classification is a natural invariant and distinguishes two adjacent homotopy dimensions, exact 98 and 6 sphere multiplicities, and integral torsion-freeness. These data are not implied by the matching polynomial or known neighboring graph calculations. No unsupported generalization or outside application is claimed.
